items.exampleEn: The long winter brought misery to the poor farmers.
items.exampleZh: 漫長的冬天給貧窮的農夫帶來了痛苦。

items.exampleEn: The boy secretly hid the cookies under his bed.
items.exampleZh: 男孩偷偷地把餅乾藏在床底下。

items.exampleEn: The garden looks glorious in spring.
items.exampleZh: 春天的花園看起來美極了。

items.exampleEn: Honesty is the most important thing in a friendship.
items.exampleZh: 誠實是友誼中最重要的事。

items.exampleEn: Children need encouragement from their parents.
Ten minutes of meditation before bed is part of my day.
items.exampleZh: 睡前冥想十分鐘是我一天的一部分。

items.exampleEn: The dog shivered after its bath.
items.exampleZh: 那隻狗洗完澡後直發抖。

items.exampleEn: Two shops with the same name can be confusing for customers.
items.exampleZh: 兩家店同名可能會讓顧客搞混。

items.sentenceEn: Thank you for all your encouragement.

items.audioEn: This map is so confusing. Let's ask someone for directions instead.
items.audioZh: 這張地圖好難懂，我們還是找人問路吧。

items.sentenceEn: He secretly read his sister's diary.
items.sentenceZh: 他偷偷看了姊姊的日記。

items.sentenceEn: The temple offers free meditation classes on Sundays.
items.sentenceZh: 那座寺廟週日提供免費的冥想課。

items.stemEn: Her ____ about the broken window made her parents trust her more.
items.stemZh: 她坦白承認打破了窗戶，讓爸媽更信任她。
那個恐怖的故事讓我發抖。

items.passageEn: My best friend Mina had a hard year. Her family moved to a new town, and she lived in misery for months. So our class secretly planned a surprise for her birthday. The plan was a little confusing because everyone had a different job, but it worked. The weather that morning was unpredictable, and it turned very cold. We shivered as we waited outside her new house. When she opened the door, we sang loudly. Mina cried and said she loved our honesty, because we told her the truth: we had all missed her. Her mom, who teaches meditation, invited us in for hot tea. With our encouragement, Mina joined a band in her new town. She says it was a glorious day.
items.passageZh: 我最好的朋友 Mina 度過了艱難的一年。她家搬到一個新的小鎮，她好幾個月都過得很痛苦。於是我們班偷偷地為她的生日策劃了一個驚喜。這個計畫有點令人困惑，因為每個人負責的工作都不同，但最後成功了。那天早上的天氣難以預測，後來變得非常冷。我們在她的新家外面等著，冷得發抖。她一開門，我們就大聲唱歌。Mina 哭了，說她很喜歡我們的誠實，因為我們跟她說了實話：我們都很想她。她那位教冥想的媽媽請我們進屋喝熱茶。在我們的鼓勵下，Mina 加入了新小鎮的一個樂團。她說那是燦爛美好的一天。

questions.questionZh: 大家在 Mina 家外面等的時候怎麼了？
Mina 為什麼說她喜歡大家的誠實？
options: 因為大家承認忘了她的生日
因為大家送了很貴的禮物
因為大家告訴她實話：大家都很想她

items.promptZh: 他偷偷地把狗帶進了房間。
referenceEn: He secretly brought the dog into his room.
He brought the dog into his room secretly.
rubricZh: secretly 表示「偷偷地、秘密地」，例如 secretly bring… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 confusing 造一個句子，說說一件讓你覺得困惑的事。
referenceEn: I think math is confusing sometimes.
The rules of my new game were confusing at first.
rubricZh: confusing 表示「令人困惑的」，例如 confusing rules 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或想法（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式或過去式等）
